data.name: Aghil
data.gender_notes: Aghil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aghil is the name of a lion in Arabic. It is a name of strength, power, and courage. It is a name for a warrior, a protector, and a victor. The name Aghil carries the meaning “Mountain Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aghil usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aghil is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the strength and power of the Creator and reminds us of our own inner strength and courage. It is a name for those who seek to protect and defend their loved ones, and to overcome challenges and obstacles in life.
data.etymology: Aghil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aghil total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aghil holds deep cultural significance as it embodies the warrior spirit of the Arab people. It is a name that symbolizes strength, bravery, and valor. In pre-Islamic Arab culture, the lion was an important symbol of power and courage. Arab warriors would adopt the names of lions to inspire fear in their enemies and instill confidence in themselves. The name Aghil continues to hold this meaning today and is cherished by Arab families as a name for their sons.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Aghil holds a deeper spiritual significance. It is a reminder of God's power and strength, and the power and courage that comes from being a believer in God. The lion is often used as a metaphor for the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), who was a powerful preacher, a brave leader, and a courageous warrior. The name Aghil inspires us to be like the Prophet, to be strong in our faith, and to stand up for our beliefs in the face of adversity. It is a name that will inspire us to be a warrior for truth and justice, and to make a positive impact on the world.
